_source: The example response of the Automation API reference, activities-id-GET (developer.doc.autodesk.com/bPlouYTd/design-automation-forge-doc-master-792222/design-automation/v3/reference/http/design-automation/activities-id-GET.html), read 2026-11-01: an Activity's body as it was given, with its fully qualified id (owner.name+alias), its description and its version. The stand-in answers with the body flo2-rvt's own registration sent, in this form.

body.description: Human readable description of the object.
